global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with chashu, nori, menma, and naruto fish cake, arranged neatly in a white bowl with red trim. Warm lighting highlights the meal on a wooden table, with a glass of water nearby.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and black characters along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, uneven surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish-white meat, browned edges, and visible marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale pink center, white outer layer, scalloped edge, smooth surface with slight sheen.
